question: To which forms of the bull deity are the concluding offerings addressed?
premises: The deity is addressed as dwelling in the cloth and in the pot.
The deity is addressed as the bull whose form is the seat.
inference: The offerings are addressed to the bull dwelling in the cloth, dwelling in the pot, and having the form of the seat.
plain_english: To the one dwelling in the cloth, dwelling in the pot, to the bull whose form is the seat.
